JSON numbers above 2^53 lose digits in JavaScript (9007199254740993 -> ...992); decimal arithmetic is binary floating point (9007199254740993 parses as 9007199254740992; 19.99*100 = 1998.9999999999998; string-encoded ids keep their digits)
